limitations.text: Both image candidates are source-described modern vector redrawings. Direct image fetches failed during this research session, so their pixels were not visually inspected. Their script labels, provenance and reuse terms come from the exact Commons file description pages.

The Sinica Character Database evolution page lists graph categories and competing interpretive explanations, but its page states All Rights Reserved. It is cited as linked evidence only and is not proposed as an image asset.
